answer: Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the sable until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the reef of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
